description.p: Linchan is a fast, native imageboard browser built with GTK 4 and libadwaita. It reads the public 4chan JSON API directly and renders everything with native widgets instead of a web engine.

Linchan is an unofficial client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by 4chan. Replies are posted through the site's own verification, which you complete yourself in an embedded browser view; Linchan does not solve or bypass any captcha. Boards contain unmoderated content from anonymous users that may be offensive or explicit.

ul.li: Board list with search, and an option to hide not-safe-for-work boards
Catalog grid with filtering and sorting by bump order, replies, images or age
Threads with quote links, reply links and live updates
Media viewer for images, animated GIFs and videos, with fullscreen and saving
Reply to threads, with optional attachments, using the site's own captcha
Watch list that tells you when threads you follow get new replies
Follows the API rules: at most one request per second and conditional requests

description.p: The catalog now only loads thumbnails for threads in view, so it opens faster and uses less bandwidth.
Adds "Clear Browsing Data" to the menu, which deletes the cookies and site data kept by the reply window.
